4609d17389d8ad96e82d.text: Bias refers to a tendency to lean in a particular direction or side. It is a

6d417075b61e172cb506.text: disposition to be in favor of or against one thing, person, or group. It is having a concept or thought in a way considered to be unfair. Biases can be learned or acquired implicitly within cultural contexts. A person may develop biases toward or against an individual, an ethnic group, a sexual or gender identity or preference, a nation, a religion, social class, political views, ideologies, physical attributes, abilities, and disabilities.

b662dab445ccd35d8d16.text: To be biased means to lack a neutral perspective on a specific matter. It means one-sided, lacking a balanced viewpoint, or someone not having an open mind. When people are biased towards something, they lean favorably towards it and think positively of it. On the other hand, when they are biased against something, they lean negatively against it and think poorly of it.

6fe9c35be4ae2b56ba6f.text: Prejudice is an irrational or incorrect attitude towards an individual or a person

a61548a7647fdcff46e3.text: based solely on their social group membership. The word is often used to denote preconceived, usually unfavorable feelings, towards people or a person because of their age, gender, sex, disability, race/ethnicity, nationality, education, occupation, social class, beliefs, religion, values, political views, sexuality, language, beauty, criminality, affiliation or other personal characteristics.

8aca51826e5bbc754e2c.text: Moreover, it is a positive or negative evaluation of another person based on

8a95aae03c8e5df2f4fd.text: their apparent group membership or what people think they belong. Prejudice can also refer to unfounded or unsupported beliefs or an idea or opinion that disregards basic

21a5f8184db4f1f0777d.text: facts. It is similar to ignorance or a lack of knowledge, experience, or education.
